integrity: The proof derives every tube-facet offset directly from the Minkowski-sum realization, computes intrinsic projected normal lengths, proves by an exact positive factorization that singleton tubes are uniquely closest, and uses all singleton facets to prove the global upper bound and uniqueness. Finite computation is only corroborative.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the standard simplex-sum graph-associahedron realization of the cycle and the intrinsic Euclidean metric. It does not assert the same radius for other cyclohedron realizations or deformations, and it does not compute circumradii or John ellipsoids. A residual bibliographic risk remains for an equivalent observation under older graph-associahedron terminology.
title: The standard cyclohedron has a unique barycentric incenter
